description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Ornithopter dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Ornithopter on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1 and put Ornithopter on the bottom of your library.
The Temporal Anchor triggers, exiling Ornithopter from the bottom of your library.
Cast Ornithopter from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.
